mainEntity.name: What makes Baxstar Fishing different from other Detroit Lakes guides?

acceptedAnswer.text: It comes down to experience, preparation, and standards. Brady Baxter has 30+ years on Detroit Lakes waters, 7+ years guiding professionally, 5 Minnesota Master Angler awards, and 100+ five-star reviews. Trips run on a Vexus DVX20S with Garmin LiveScope sonar and premium gear, with a prepared, high-standard approach to every booking.

mainEntity.name: How much does a Baxstar guided fishing trip cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Baxstar offers private guided fishing trips with pricing based on trip length, season, and group size. Most guests choose a four-hour private trip, with optional upgrades available at checkout. For current pricing and live availability, use the online booking calendar or call Brady directly at (218) 325-6857.

mainEntity.name: What is included in a Baxstar guided fishing trip?

acceptedAnswer.text: Baxstar provides the Vexus DVX20S boat, fuel, premium rods and reels, fresh live bait, full tackle, life jackets, Garmin LiveScope sonar, hands-on instruction, and catch cleaning when requested. Guests bring a cooler, weather-appropriate clothing, snacks and drinks if desired, and a valid Minnesota fishing license.

mainEntity.name: Where do Baxstar fishing trips depart from?

acceptedAnswer.text: Baxstar guides on many lakes in the Detroit Lakes area. The exact launch location depends on the lake chosen for that day's conditions, based on weather, wind, water temperature, and the best current bite. Brady confirms the meeting point the day before your trip.

mainEntity.name: Which lakes do you fish, and how do you choose where to go?

acceptedAnswer.text: Baxstar covers lakes across the Detroit Lakes region, including Detroit Lake, Pelican Lake, Lake Sallie, Lake Lida, Big Cormorant Lake, Upper Cormorant Lake, and other nearby waters. Brady chooses the lake based on weather, wind direction, water temperature, recent scouting, and the best chance to put your group on fish.

mainEntity.name: What fish species can we target?

acceptedAnswer.text: Baxstar trips commonly target walleye, smallmouth and largemouth bass, northern pike, crappie, and bluegill depending on the season, weather, and group goals. Brady reads current conditions across the Detroit Lakes area and picks the species and water that give your group the best day — not a fixed script.

mainEntity.name: Is the boat private, or do I share it with other clients?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — every Baxstar trip is 100% private, so you never share the boat with strangers. Your group has the Vexus DVX20S and Brady's full attention from launch to landing, at your pace, with coaching matched to your crew's experience level.

mainEntity.name: Do you guide first-time anglers, kids, or non-fishing partners?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Many Baxstar trips include first-time anglers, children, or non-fishing partners along for the ride. Brady tailors the pace, technique, and species target so beginners feel comfortable and confident while experienced anglers can still enjoy a serious day on the water.

mainEntity.name: What should I bring on a guided fishing trip?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bring a valid Minnesota fishing license, weather-appropriate clothing, sunglasses, sunscreen, snacks, drinks, and a cooler for fish if you plan to keep any. Baxstar provides everything else — the boat, fuel, quality rods and reels, tackle, bait, life jackets, Garmin LiveScope sonar, and hands-on instruction from the first cast.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a Minnesota fishing license, and where do I get one?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every angler age 16 and over needs a valid Minnesota fishing license. You can buy one online through the Minnesota DNR, at Detroit Lakes bait shops, or at local outfitters. A 24-hour, 72-hour, or season license all qualify — bring a digital or printed copy to the boat.

mainEntity.name: Can we keep the fish we catch?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, when fish are legal to keep and within Minnesota regulations. Brady helps guests understand current limits, slot restrictions, and which fish make sense to harvest versus release for the fishery's future. Catch cleaning is available when requested, so dinner can come home ready for the pan.

mainEntity.name: What boat and equipment does Baxstar Fishing use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Brady runs a Vexus DVX20S, a tournament-grade fiberglass walleye boat rigged with a Mercury Pro XS 300, Minn Kota Ultrex trolling motor, twin Power-Poles, and dual Garmin LiveScope live-imaging sonar. The deep-V hull handles changing big-water conditions, and the open layout gives clients room to fish comfortably.

mainEntity.name: What happens if weather changes the day of my trip?

acceptedAnswer.text: Safety comes first. If conditions are unsafe, Brady may reschedule the trip or cancel with a refund. Baxstar does fish in moderate rain and manageable wind, and rain gear is available when needed. If weather shifts, Brady may change lakes or adjust the plan to give your group the best safe opportunity instead of canceling too early.

mainEntity.name: How far ahead should I book a private guided trip?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prime summer dates, weekends, and multi-day groups can book well in advance, especially from mid-June through August. For a specific date or weekend, booking two to three months ahead is safest. Last-minute openings do happen, so check the booking calendar or call Brady directly at (218) 325-6857.

mainEntity.name: Can you arrange a multi-day trip or a corporate group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Baxstar can help with multi-day fishing trips, father-son and family weekends, small executive groups, and corporate outings. Brady can coordinate lake plans, recommend lodging near Detroit Lake or Pelican Lake, and help arrange additional guide support when needed. Email info@baxstarfishing.com to plan a private group.

mainEntity.name: Does Baxstar offer ice fishing trips or winter rentals?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — Baxstar runs open-water guided trips all season and winter ice fishing experiences in the Detroit Lakes area. Winter options may include guided ice fishing, Ice Castle rentals, and other cold-weather experiences depending on availability, ice conditions, and the year's schedule. Ask about winter dates when you book.
